label: DIAGNOSTIC
caveat: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — residual-versus-close has NOT cleared. Rows carry real de-vigged Pinnacle fair probabilities: market inputs, not picks, edges, or recommendations. A model side is attached only where a (mu, sigma) pair was MEASURED for that exact player/market from nflverse play-by-play game logs (2025 regular season + 2026 regular season weeks 1-5; minimum 4 games; a game counts when the player appears in play-by-play in a tracked role — a participation proxy, no snap data). Everywhere else the model side is null, the row is priced-only, and the row states why — no model probability, distribution, or EV is invented for it. A gap between the model probability and the de-vigged market probability is a discrepancy for study, not an edge. No stake sizing is emitted while rvc_cleared is false.

model_distributions.source: measured from nflverse play-by-play game logs (nflverse-data pbp release, CC-BY 4.0), local path data/nflverse/pbp/ — the same path the SGP correlation estimator reads
model_distributions.window: 2025 regular season (all weeks) + 2026 regular season weeks 1-5
model_distributions.estimator: per (player, stat): mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of per-game totals over regular-season games where the player appears in play-by-play in a tracked role (participation proxy — play-by-play carries no snap counts)
model_distributions.note: pairs not measured carry their status and the sample behind the decision; withheld pairs' mu/sigma in coverage are the numbers that were NOT used. Measured pairs for stats the engine has no distribution family for still price-only — see the rows' model_note.
